"Foundations" is named in Part 1's reading-order overview (part:reading-this-specification's description, X3 of the read-through srs#798/#787), which lists all nine Parts by name so the reader knows the shape of the document before reading it linearly. Naming a later Part in a front-matter table of contents is not a genuine forward reference — the mention carries no content from that Part, only its title and position in the sequence. Structural, not a fold candidate: this entry persists as long as Part 1 names the other eight Parts up front.
